change.behavior: Verify the existing hash chain during Ledger initialization and raise ValueError before appending if invalid.
change.regression: Tamper with the first event, expect hash_mismatch:1 on initialization, and assert the tampered file remains unchanged.

limitations: Hash chains do not prevent privileged full-file rewrite and rehash.
No multi-writer locking or fsync durability guarantee is added.
No external signature, OpenTimestamps proof, Bitcoin confirmation, or Arweave anchor is claimed.
